• Minimum of 2 years of experience in GMP manufacturing, preferably within cell therapy, ATMP, or biopharmaceutical production

Grace Church Amsterdam is an English speaking Christian church serving an international community in Amsterdam. We are seeking a full time Lead Pastor and Lead Elder to provide pastoral, theological and organizational leadership to the church.

The Lead Pastor will serve as a Staff Elder and work together with our lay elders. Responsibilities include preaching regularly, overseeing Sunday worship gatherings, leading elder meetings, providing pastoral care, equipping church members for discipleship and evangelism, developing future elders and deacons, supervising staff, and overseeing the day to day operations of the church.

The candidate must be able to affirm the doctrinal statement of Grace Church without reservation. We are seeking a pastor committed to expository preaching, the authority and inerrancy of Scripture, complementarian convictions, and Reformed soteriology.

Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required. The candidate must be able to preach, teach, provide pastoral care, lead meetings, and supervise staff in an English speaking church environment.

Applicants should submit a CV and a cover letter explaining their relevant ministry experience and interest in serving Grace Church Amsterdam.

It is more important to be enthusiastic and motivated. - You speak English and/or Dutch. - You can work in a team and independently. - Y ou are able to work in a production environment with a temperature from 7 degrees - You are available during peak periods (December and Easter). - Willingness to adhere to regulations regarding all visible jewelry, piercings, ...

As an Inside Technical-Commercial Representative, you are the central hub within our Accelonix organization. You liaise between sales, technical, and logistics to ensure processes run optimally. 
Your responsibilities: - International link: You are the central point of contact for our high-tech customers and international suppliers; - Internal support: You unburden and support our Sales and Service Engineers, ensuring projects are followed up and executed optimally; - Commercial management: Together with the Sales Engineer, you translate customer inquiries into suitable quotations, follow up proactively, and process complex orders; - Process monitoring: You monitor the supply chain (delivery times, stock levels) and proactively intervene in the event of bottlenecks. 
We offer: - A challenging, independent position with plenty of room for initiative and personal impact on our work processes; - Working in an innovative, high-tech environment with the latest technologies; - A professional, social, and ambitious team with an informal working atmosphere; - Employment conditions: A competitive salary and, upon proven suitability, the prospect of permanent employment with opportunities for advancement to a technical-commercial field sales position. 
Your profile: 
A social and organized person who thrives in a dynamic, innovative work environment. You enjoy taking the initiative to improve processes and strengthen customer relationships. - Education: In a commercial or technical field; - Strong organizational skills: You are structured, stress-resistant, and maintain an overview; - Social & Customer-Focused: You have strong communication skills and always put the customer first; - Language proficiency: Good command of the Dutch and English languages; - Tech-minded: Affinity with and interest in high-tech developments and electronics is a plus, but not a must.
